integrity: The accompanying analytic six-step proof treats all parameters and all integer frequencies. The checker gives finite congruence and exact symbolic example tests only, not an infinite proof. Independent validation has not been carried out.
scientific_limitations: Only odd-prime integer scale, the symmetric positive digit weights (1-2t,t,t), and integer Fourier frequencies are characterized. Neither a classification for unequal nonzero digit weights nor a real-frequency zero theorem or spectral-basis theorem is asserted. Earlier equivalent work cannot be ruled out completely because the full text of Strichartz (1993), a relevant general self-similar Fourier source, was inaccessible.
title: A Thomae law and laminar Fourier kernels for weighted triangular self-similar measures
